decision.chosen_option: Option (a) hybrid: keep the REAL-corpus frequency-derived 320 vocab (the north-star), score generalization against an INDEPENDENT co-occurrence-COHERENT reference = the VALIDATED stream_taxonomy_320.TAXONOMY_40x8 (the exact reference the validated stream cortex scored 0.91 against) + the coherent g20 entity/verb domains for content words not in it; score gen over the GEN-USABLE coherent subset (a coherent category with >=2 members of the vocab); report BOTH the old sharding (0.153) and the new coherent number.
decision.why_not_pure_a_or_b: Mapping freq-320 onto TAXONOMY_40x8 alone covers only 50.6% (162/320). Building a coherent a-priori map (TAXONOMY_40x8 + coherent g20 entity/verb domains) maximizes clean coverage at 67.5% (216/320) / 65.6% gen-usable (210/320). The hybrid is what option (a) + (b) collapse to: the validated coherent taxonomy first, coherent g20 domains second.
decision.vocab_swap: REJECTED -- the prompt explicitly forbids swapping to the curated TAXONOMY_40x8 vocab; real-corpus frequency learning is the north-star. The frequency vocab is KEPT intact; only the gen SCORING subset + reference change.

coherent_reference.how_built: _coherent_category_map() merges two INDEPENDENT a-priori sources (NEVER corpus-derived): (1) stream_taxonomy_320.TAXONOMY_40x8 (40x8 hand-curated semantic categories, freq>=50, the validated 0.91 reference) FIRST priority; (2) the coherent g20 ENTITY+VERB domains (COHERENT_G20_DOMAINS: animals/food/body/people/emotions/nature/objects/vehicles/verbs) prefixed 'g20_' for content words not in (1). Words in the INCOHERENT g20 categories (color/size/texture adjectives + abstract/spatial/time/quantity/discourse function words) get NO coherent label -> not gen-usable.
coherent_reference.independence: Both sources are a-priori semantic taxonomies, asserted distinct from the corpus. The corpus only sets WHICH 320 words (by frequency) + their co-occurrence codes; the category LABELS come from the independent taxonomies. Anti-cheat #1 (gen reference must be independent/not-smuggled) preserved.
coherent_reference.members_per_category_balance: 45 categories over 210 gen-usable words = mean ~4.7 members/cat; all scored categories have >=2 members (gen-usable definition). The TAXONOMY_40x8 categories (8 members each) anchor the balance; the coherent g20 extensions add 2-21 members each. A handful of would-be singletons (brave/balloon/fruit/orange/button/bone) are correctly dropped from scoring (cat<2).
coherent_reference.independence_of_excluded: The 104 excluded words are the genuinely co-occurrence-INCOHERENT ones (abstract_relations 19, spatial_words 19, time_words 18, question_discourse 14, texture/color/size adjectives 34, quantity 11) -- a distributional cortex has no category for them, confirmed by the scoping. Excluding them is honest, not cherry-picking.

coverage_below_90pct_finding.honest_caveat: The prompt's '>=~90% coverage with >=2 members/category' bar is UNREACHABLE over the frequency-derived vocab while keeping the real-corpus words. Best achievable coherent coverage is ~67.5% (gen-usable ~65.6%). CAUSE: TinyStories' most-frequent CONTENT words are ~33% adjectives + function words (very/because/inside/hot/fast/up/down/now/then/what/who...) that don't co-occur with EACH OTHER, so a distributional (Hebbian co-occurrence) cortex provably cannot cluster them by category -- exactly the scoping's dominant cause (a). This ~67.5% ceiling is itself an honest FINDING, not a fixable engineering gap: to reach >=90% one would have to swap to the curated TAXONOMY_40x8 vocab (which the prompt forbids) or invent pseudo-categories for function words (a cheat).
coverage_below_90pct_finding.what_the_re_run_will_show: Gen scored over the gen-usable 210-word coherent subset, against the validated coherent reference the stream cortex cleared at 0.91. The scoping strongly predicts coherent gen >= 0.80 (Pearson 0.07 on the orthogonal sharding reference vs +0.41-0.52 + 0.91 gen on a coherent one, same mechanism + byte-identical normalization). BOTH numbers reported.
